title: Bounded-free comparison of the Roos cone with multiplication cones
statement: Let T be a normalized DVR tower [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], M with p and delta its given Roos triangle [def-weil-derived-limit], n a finite index and adj a specified tensor--restriction adjunction [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction]. Assume countable products in the completed derived category. Suppose a strict normalized tower U for the canonical completed uniformizer [def-sp-completed-uniformizer-section] is already supplied, with specified isomorphisms Q(U_(j+1)) to evaluation_j(T) respecting successor maps [lem-coef-strict-normalized-adic-cone-limit]. At the selected n require a finite-coefficient complex N, a chain isomorphism iN:U_(n+1) to its completed restriction, a finite-derived isomorphism eN:Q(N) to T.M n, and equality of the restricted comparison with eU_n followed by evaluationIso. There is a homotopy-limit cone c for cone(v^(n+1):U_(m+n+1) to U_(m+n+1)), an isomorphism from restricted derived reduction of M to c.pt, and equality between the restricted adjoint of the nth Roos projection and the composite of this isomorphism, the zeroth cone projection, rho, desc, the normalized cokernel map and the supplied level isomorphism. The scalar ring, strict tower, normalization and countable products are fixed inputs, not constructed here.

theorem normalizedDVR_bounded_free_cone
    (T : NormalizedDVRTower l E X D hl)
    (M : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E X D hl)
    [HasProduct (fun n : ℕ ↦ (normalizedDVRTowerEvaluation l E X D hl n).obj T.tower)]
    (p : M ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ (normalizedDVRTowerEvaluation l E X D hl n).obj T.tower)
    (δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ (normalizedDVRTowerEvaluation l E X D hl n).obj T.tower) ⟶
      M⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hc : IsDerivedLimitTriangle
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ (normalizedDVRTowerTransition l E X D hl n.le_succ).app T.tower)
      M p δ) (n : ℕ)
    (adj : scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n ⊣
      scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X n)
    [HasLimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ) (completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E X D hl)]
    (U : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (completedIntegralModuleSheaves l E X D hl) ℤ)
    (hU : CochainComplex.IsNormalizedAdicTower (normalizedDVRUniformizer l E X) U)
    (eU : ∀ j : ℕ, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (U.obj (op (j + 1))) ≅
      (normalizedDVRTowerEvaluation l E X D hl j).obj T.tower)
    (heU : ∀ j : ℕ,
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (U.map (homOfLE (Nat.succ_le_succ j.le_succ)).op) ≫
          (eU j).hom = (eU (j + 1)).hom ≫
        (normalizedDVRTowerTransition l E X D hl j.le_succ).app T.tower)
    (N : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E X n) ℤ)
    (iN : U.obj (op (n + 1)) ≅
      ((completedIntegralRestrictScalars l E X D hl n).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj N)
    (eN : (@DerivedCategory.Q _ _ _ (HasDerivedCategory.standard _)).obj N ≅ T.M n)
    (hN : (eU n).hom ≫ (T.evaluationIso n).hom =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map iN.hom ≫
        (completedIntegralRestrictScalars l E X D hl n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app N ≫
        (normalizedDVRResCompleted l E X D hl n).map eN.hom) :
    ∃ (c : Cone (CochainComplex.IsNormalizedAdicTower.arrowTower
      (ϖ := normalizedDVRUniformizer l E X) (T := U) (n + 1) ⋙
        CochainComplex.ConeCoimage.cone ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)),
    CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.IsHomotopyLimit c ∧
    ∃ (a : (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X n).obj
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj M) ≅ c.pt),
      (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X n).map
          ((adj.homEquiv M (T.M n)).symm
            (p ≫ Pi.π _ n ≫ (T.evaluationIso n).hom)) =
        a.hom ≫ c.π.app (op 0) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (CochainComplex.ConeCoimage.ρ.app _ ≫ CochainComplex.ConeCoimage.desc.app _ ≫
            hU.cokerDesc (n + 1) (op 0)) ≫ (eU n).hom ≫
            (T.evaluationIso n).hom

statement_change.what: Completed-derived successor compatibility alone does not preserve the finite coefficient action. For R a DVR, twist eU_0 on B_1 direct-sum B_1[1] by the nonzero Bockstein B_1 -> B_1[1] and leave higher level comparisons canonical. Precomposition with B_2 -> B_1 kills this Bockstein, so successor compatibility remains. The limit is R direct-sum R[1] and its projection kills the twist, while the cone augmentation sees it. Naturality with summand idempotents prevents a natural comparison from absorbing this off-diagonal twist. Require the selected level comparison to arise from a strict finite-coefficient complex and a finite-derived isomorphism instead. The canonical finiteModel supplies this.
